definitions.explanation: The number 20,000, expressed as {二|に} (two) × {万|まん} (10,000) in the Japanese numbering system. A common round figure in everyday contexts — mid-range yen amounts, attendance figures, and so on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入場者|にゅうじょうしゃ}→入場者：23599_nyuujousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{二万|にまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧だった。
examples.english: There were about twenty thousand attendees.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二万|にまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧もした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{破|やぶ}れて→破れる：02322_yabureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: This coat cost twenty thousand yen, and it's already torn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二万|にまん}⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{売|う}れた→売れる：02012_ureru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: Last month, this product reportedly sold more than twenty thousand units nationwide.

notes:
{二万|にまん} is the number 20,000. In the Japanese number system, it is formed as ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ (2) × ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧ (10,000).

JAPANESE NUMBER SYSTEM:
Japanese groups large numbers in units of 10,000 (⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧), not 1,000 as in English. For twenties of thousands:
- ⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧: 10,000
- {二万|にまん}: 20,000
- ⟦{三万|さんまん}→三万：30467_sanman⟧: 30,000
- ⟦{十万|じゅうまん}→十万：30469_juuman⟧: 100,000

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {二万|にまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: twenty thousand yen (roughly the price of a mid-range jacket or a nice dinner for two)
- {二万|にまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: twenty thousand people
- {二万|にまん}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: twenty thousand copies (of a book, magazine)
- {二万|にまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧: (colloquially) twenty-thousand-yen note — note: there is no such bill; the highest is ⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧

LEARNER TIP:
{二万|にまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ is roughly the threshold between "moderately expensive" and "noticeably expensive" in everyday Japanese consumer contexts (a nice meal, a mid-range clothing item, a budget-level appliance).
